title: events
description: Live event discovery: concerts, club nights, art, comedy, and festivals across 14 cities.
summary: Live event discovery: concerts, club nights, art, comedy, and festivals across 14 cities.
offersHint: Live event discovery: concerts, club nights, art, comedy, and festivals across 14 cities. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://eventchat-events-mcp-production.up.railway.app/mcp · Packages: npm:uplayground-events

toolsPreview.name: get_preference_onboarding
toolsPreview.description: Use this when a user wants personalized event recommendations and Dizko needs consent-first questions before saving event preferences.

toolsPreview.name: create_event_preference_profile
toolsPreview.description: Use this when a user explicitly agrees to save event preferences and does not already have a Dizko preference profile.

toolsPreview.name: save_event_preferences
toolsPreview.description: Use this when a consenting user already has a Dizko profile and wants to add, update, merge, or replace saved event preferences.

toolsPreview.name: get_event_preferences
toolsPreview.description: Use this when a user with a Dizko profile wants to view saved event preferences or learned recommendation signals.

toolsPreview.name: delete_event_preferences
toolsPreview.description: Use this only when a user asks to delete their Dizko saved event preferences and feedback history.

toolsPreview.name: record_event_feedback
toolsPreview.description: Use this when a user says whether they liked or disliked a specific event, provides a rating, or shares notes, so future Dizko recommendations can learn from that feedback.

toolsPreview.name: get_event_feedback_prompt
toolsPreview.description: Use this when a user previously picked or attended a Dizko event and the assistant should ask a short post-event follow-up before recording feedback.

toolsPreview.name: get_event_search_followups
toolsPreview.description: Use this when a user asks for events tonight, this week, or this weekend and the assistant should ask only the missing event type, vibe, budget, area, or avoid-preference questions before searching.

toolsPreview.name: search_events
toolsPreview.description: Use this when a user wants current events from live Dizko inventory using filters such as city, date, genre, vibe, venue, artist, neighborhood, or price.

toolsPreview.name: recommend_events
toolsPreview.description: Use this when a user wants ranked event suggestions from live Dizko inventory based on the current request's taste, vibe, price, and avoid signals.

toolsPreview.name: recommend_events_for_user
toolsPreview.description: Use this when a user has a Dizko preference profile and wants personalized event recommendations for tonight, this week, this weekend, or another date range.

toolsPreview.name: plan_night
toolsPreview.description: Use this when a user wants a compact night-out plan with a primary live event option and fallback options from Dizko inventory.

toolsPreview.name: get_daily_roundup
toolsPreview.description: Use this when a user wants a daily digest of what is happening in a city today, tomorrow, or on a specific date: top picks plus parties, live music, art, comedy, talks, and food sections from live Dizko inventory. Ideal for recurring morning briefings; pass profile_id and profile_secret so saved, learned, and per-day (day_filters) preferences shape the picks.

toolsPreview.name: get_artist_events
toolsPreview.description: Use this when a user asks when specific DJs, performers, or comedians play next, or wants upcoming shows for the artists they follow. Pass artists explicitly, or pass only profile_id and profile_secret to use the artists saved in the profile's featuring list.

toolsPreview.name: get_city_pulse
toolsPreview.description: Use this when a user asks what is hot, where the momentum is, or how busy a city's event scene looks over the coming days. Returns busiest nights, top venues, genre mix, and headline events from aggregate public inventory, every stat with evidence counts.

toolsPreview.name: get_event
toolsPreview.description: Use this when a user asks for details about a specific Dizko event id returned by search, recommendations, or a night plan.

toolsPreview.name: get_ticket_purchase_policy
toolsPreview.description: Use this when a user asks whether agents can buy tickets autonomously or what purchase modes Dizko, Hermes, OpenClaw, or other providers can support.

toolsPreview.name: get_ticket_offers
toolsPreview.description: Use this when a user wants ticket options for a specific Dizko event before quoting or buying.

toolsPreview.name: quote_ticket_order
toolsPreview.description: Use this when a user has chosen an event and wants a locked ticket quote with quantity, max price, ticket type, and stop conditions before any purchase attempt.

toolsPreview.name: purchase_ticket_order
toolsPreview.description: Use this when the user has given explicit written confirmation for a locked ticket quote and the agent should either execute an integrated provider purchase or return the required external checkout handoff.

toolsPreview.name: create_event_calendar_file
toolsPreview.description: Use this when a user wants to add a Dizko event to their calendar after choosing or buying tickets.
